name: ghostsplit-twitch-chat-firefox-extension
description: Firefox extension that restyles native twitch.tv chat to match the GhostSplit chat look. Replaces image badges with text pills (SUB/MOD/VIP/etc.), softens username colors, and works alongside 7TV / BetterTTV / FrankerFaceZ.
author: Facilitra

scripts.prelint: node ../sync-content.mjs --check || (echo 'content drift detected — run `npm run sync` in either repo' && exit 1)
scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files "dist" "dist/**" ".github" ".github/**" package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE .gitignore
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir ./dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files "dist" "dist/**" ".github" ".github/**" package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE .gitignore
